name: gemma4-31b-cluster40gb-4bit-raw-elimination-reasoning-greedy-transformers
description: Gemma 4 31B raw prompt plus fixed setting strategy cards, using elimination reasoning on one 40GB GPU with 4-bit loading and greedy decoding.
hypothesis: A fixed per-setting elimination strategy card should reduce missing final answers and improve spatial consistency by forcing Gemma 4 31B to discard contradicted options before selecting the answer.
